behavior: POST /HarborLaneShipments/ShipmentService.svc/notices over transport security with no client credential; XMLReceive activates the orchestration.
IsValidNotice validates shipment id, tracking number, and package count; EstimateDeliveryDate computes weekend-aware business-day ETA.
Map copies identifiers and stamps ReceivedAt UTC; AckStatus and calculated ETA overwrite Status and EstimatedDelivery.
Two-way port returns the response through XMLTransmit before the archive decision.
Writes accepted notices to C:\HarborLane\Out\Shipments\%MessageID%.xml; rejected notices are not archived.
